text:
anya: Heads-up: perf team found a staging p95 regression after autoscaler tweak. We must decide: carve a smaller MVP slice or slide release 2 weeks.

sam: which features are on the chopping block?

anya: candidate trims: tenant SSO, analytics-export, admin heatmap. Embedding cache and core inference paths should stay.

ravi: infra note  the autoscaler fix needs ~8 biz days QA. Short-term we can ship with a conservative config + runtime guards.

lina: sales says one pilot needs SSO at launch. Offer a manual SSO pilot? Could preserve deals.

sam: I prefer trimming SSO with a pilot. Less QA surface and keeps perf wins.

anya: runtime guards proposal:
- Canary: 2% -> 10% over 45m if p95 < 900ms and errors < 0.3%
- Emergency fallback: if p95 > 1.3s for 5m AND errors +0.7% => route to stable pool
- If fallback doesn't reduce p95 by 25% in 3m => rollback
- Per-tenant throttle: 180 rps for first 72h

ravi: add route-level spike alerts and a staging-tested rollback playbook.

lina: call it a "controlled rollout" in customer comms and offer SSO pilot sign-up. Drafting FAQ.

anya: decision lean: cut tenant SSO from MVP, keep analytics-export for now, enforce guards and pilot offering. Owners: ravi (safe-config + playbook), sam (flags & checklist), lina (pilot comms).

sam: will add feature flags and devdocs.

ravi: will produce safe-config and runbook by Thu EOD.

lina: will circulate pilot signup and customer note.

release-bot: Release window still scheduled. Canary plan will be attached to release notes.

anya: reconvene Fri 10am for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
